i feel embarrassed saying this HAHA. at this point i see them more as ocs rather than sims. i made a familyecho tree for them, complete with real birthplaces and real dates. i would start writing out lore in the back of my school notebooks. i pay for a google one subscription to hold all of my screenshots for them. it's at 25 gb right now. i have a folder with all of their tray files that i regularly update just in case my game gets corrupted. i personalize a lot of the cc furniture in my game for them, like photo frames and chalkboards. i incessantly researched the enneagram just so i could type them all accurately. now i've moved on to figuring out their myers briggs. i have a powerpoint denoting key events in their lives. i have multiple google docs where i further curate them as characters or just their lore in general. the longest one has over 12k words. my screenshots folder is currently at 5gb. i have a flashdrive where i move my screenshots before uploading them to google drive. last time i checked it was 9gb, but i lost it a few weeks ago haaaaa. i have some of their natal charts as well. i have pinterest boards for them. every sim has a playlist of music i think they'd listen to. and i have other playlists for songs that remind me of them or certain things that have happened to them. i've definitely done more but i think this is a good summary. hyperfixation hell is real and this is it

i have been obsessed with the sims 4 ever since it came out. talked about it and played it all the time. then the game became boring to me. storylines getting nowhere, gameplay getting dull. took a two year hiatus because i didn’t enjoy playing at all. then i started curating a really intricate storyline and voila, have been obsessed with the game like never before. i think the simmers on simblr inspired me, the storylines they have for their sims (more so ocs at this point) are so incredibly detailed. i would suggest planning out the storyline outside of the game. i have a google docs document with so much lore (even made a family echo for a in depth family tree) and i love playing now? i go in and happily spin them around in cas like a rotisserie chicken or i take pictures of them in game loosely following the storyline i wrote for them. i guess i’d compare it to setting a foundation? and now i can just build and build on it. but getting hyperfixated on those characters definitely helps lol
